outcome: diagnosis of placenta percreta with invasion into the urinary bladder wall
cohort: A 36-year-old pregnant woman at 34 weeks gestation with a history of previous caesarean delivery, hospitalized due to vaginal bleeding with suspicion of placenta praevia.
finding: CrystalVueTM ultrasound reconstruction accurately visualized placenta percreta with invasion into the urinary bladder wall, which enabled precise surgical planning for a patient with abnormally invasive placenta.
